Woke Up 10lbs Heavier After 40?

The #1 Nightmare After 40, Why Diet & Exercise Don’t Budge Stubborn Pounds

Even if you’ve been naturally thin for years, the unwanted pounds in your 40's refuse to budge...


You’ve probably tried every diet: cutting calories, skipping meals, spending hours in the gym to flatten your belly.


But all it ever leads to is frustration—and a scale that keeps on creeping up...


It’s so disheartening, isn’t it?


The truth is, after 40, our bodies go through huge changes that make weight loss feel almost impossible. 


Hormonal shifts affect everything—how we process food, how we store fat—and it’s like our metabolism is permanently tapping the brakes. 


No matter what we eat or how much we exercise, the weight just won’t budge.

Here’s how these hormonal shifts can show up in everyday life...

 Increased cravings, especially for sweets and carbs. 

 Slower metabolism, making it harder to burn fat. 

Constant bloating that leaves our stomachs feeling heavy and uncomfortable. 

 Extra “padding” around the belly and waist that refuses to budge. 

In the face of these hormone-driven shifts, the usual “eat less, move more” advice can feel like an uphill battle, leaving cravings, bloating, and stubborn belly fat firmly in place.


Now You Can Finally Beat Bloating, Shed Stubborn Pounds, and Flatten Your Belly Without Crash Diets or Exhausting Workouts With BloatBurn™

BloatBurn is powered by 10 science-backed ingredients designed to beat bloating, flatten your belly, and curb hormonal cravings.

 It’s the ultimate solution for hormonal weight gain, persistent bloating, energy crashes, and relentless sugar cravings.

 Each ingredient is carefully chosen to support digestion, balance hormones, and reduce bloating—helping you feel lighter, more comfortable, and confident throughout every stage of life.
  

So the body burns fat on autopilot.

Answers to your questions

How long does a jar last?

Each Jar has 60 capsules, and each serving size is 2 capsules per day.


This means each jar is a 30 day supply.

What are the ingredients in BloatBurn?

Each of these natural extracts has been meticulously chosen and measured in amounts that are clinically validated:
• Ginger Extract, Rhizome (Zingier officinale)
• Dandelion Root Extract
• Bromelain
• Peppermint Leaf Extract
• Fennel Seed Extract
• Turmeric Root Extract•Black Pepper Extract
• Chromium
• GreenselectPhytosome® Green Tea Leaf Extract.
• Coconut Oil Powder (50% Medium Chain Triglycerides)

Will this work for me?

BloatBurn is designed to target the most common causes of stubborn weight gain and discomfort which is bloating and poor digestion.


Thousands of customers experience:
• Reduced bloating

• Improved digestion

• Reduced sugar cravings

• Steady weight loss

• A flatter, more comfortable stomach


For best results, consistency is key.

When will I see results?

Many customers notice reduced bloating and a flatter stomach within days.


However, for real lasting results, we recommend taking BloatBurn consistently for 4–8 weeks, as the benefits build over time.

How does the 90 day trial work? 🗓

Try our supplements risk-free for 90 days. If you're not completely satisfied with your weight management, simply email us for a full refund. No questions asked.

Are there any side effects?

BloatBurn is formulated with natural, well-tolerated ingredients and is designed to be gentle on your system.


Most customers experience no side effects. However, as with any supplement, if you have sensitivities or underlying health conditions, consult your healthcare provider before use.

Can I take BloatBurn with HRT?

BloatBurn is made from natural ingredients and we have thousands of customers who take it alongside HRT.


However, if you are currently on hormone replacement therapy or any prescribed medication, we always recommend consulting your GP or healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.

Are your supplements made in the UK?

Yes, our menopause supplements are proudly manufactured in the UK, adhering to strict Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) standards. We actually go above and beyond just GMP as we are certified by the MHRA, HFMA, FSA, and many more. Our manufacturing facilities are regularly audited and certified to meet these rigorous standards.

How fast do you deliver my order?

Neuaura offers FREE next-day shipping for all UK orders over £60! All orders will be delivered within 24hrs via Evri or Royal mail. Excluding weekends.

Do you offer payment plans?
